name: 020-chat-greedy-basic
description: Greedy (temperature=0) chat-completions call against a small instruction-tuned model. Asserts the exact decoded string for a fixed prompt under deterministic decode.

messages.content: You answer in exactly one short sentence.
What is the capital of France?

ref_outputs.notes: While the model isn't loaded the assertion is structural only: the response must be a valid ChatCompletionResponse with object='chat.completion', exactly one choice, finish_reason in {stop,length}, and a non-empty assistant message. When the model is wired, the content_regex above (case-insensitive 'paris') becomes the canonical assertion.
